purpose: Measure how much of D1 terminal attrition is created by the frozen form-imputed cadence rule and place it beside a company-learned cadence reading without replacing published D1 numbers.

relationshipToPublishedD1.policy: append-only comparison; published D1 values are never overwritten

forbiddenInputs: any row with accepted date after 2020-12-31

population.unit: one non-empty CIK with at least one 10-K, 10-Q, 20-F, or 40-F filing in an allowed panel
population.deduplication: within company and fiscal period keep the earliest accepted timestamp; amendments do not add intervals
population.identityPolicy: CIK is an in-memory grouping key only and is never written

frozenReading.rule: any 10-K or 10-Q makes the company quarterly; companies with only 20-F/40-F are annual
frozenReading.event: last accepted date plus frozen cadence is on or before 2020-12-31

learnedReading.intervalAxis: positive calendar-day gaps between consecutive unique accepted dates after fiscal-period deduplication
learnedReading.companyCadenceDays: ceiling of the median positive interval for that company
learnedReading.insufficientHistoryFallback: if fewer than two unique accepted dates remain, reuse the frozen cadence and label the company fallback-imputed
learnedReading.event: last accepted date plus learned-or-fallback cadence is on or before 2020-12-31
learnedReading.curve: discrete Kaplan-Meier curve using the same entry, duration, event ordering, and administrative cutoff as published D1

reporterTypes.name: foreign-annual-only
reporterTypes.rule: no 10-K or 10-Q and at least one 20-F or 40-F

panelEdgeDistance.statistic: calendar days from the company's last accepted filing to 2020-12-31

testStatistics.primary: count of frozen terminal exits that become right-censored under the learned reading
secondary: primary count by reporter type and panel-edge distance band
terminal exits, right-censored companies, and median stay quarters under both readings
learned cadence distribution by reporter type
count of learned terminal exits that are right-censored under the frozen reading
testStatistics.effectiveN: unique companies; filings and intervals are not independent observations

nullModel: The frozen form-imputed reading and the company-learned reading classify every company identically at the panel edge.
threshold: Any classification difference is reported descriptively; no significance, study, method, or product gate is created.
correctionRule: If the learned-reading median differs from the published D1 median of 27 quarters, append a correction note to D1, D2, D4, and D5; never edit their published numbers.
requiredInvariants: the frozen reading reproduces the complete published D1 counts, median, survival curve, and exit-quarter table exactly
both readings reconcile terminal exits plus right-censored companies to the same effective N
reporter-type rows and panel-edge bands each partition the primary difference count
no company identifier, company name, signal, price, outcome, or post-2020 date is written
the output contains both readings and cannot silently replace published D1
explicitNonClaims: The learned cadence is a sensitivity reading, not a corrected study verdict.
A reporting gap does not identify bankruptcy, delisting, or business failure.
A fallback-imputed company does not provide a company-learned cadence.
The comparison does not access or describe the sealed 2021-2023 endtest.
